opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 (Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored); up to £300 (Scheme C virtual)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of viva (not undergrad/Master's).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides an award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, to be used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session for up to about £1,000, or as major sponsor of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorships £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, to be used towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
